cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.42% · WTI -5.82% · Brent -0.96% · NatGas -2.78%. 60% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Power & IPPs is doing the heavy lifting at +1.19%.

cards.headline: Power & IPPs leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Power & IPPs at +1.19%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -1.91%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: RUN is the standout at +10.45%
cards.body: Leaders: RUN +10.45%, SEDG +4.38%, ENPH +4.24%, ARRY +3.83%, FLNC +2.90%. Laggards: EOSE -4.41%, PWR -3.76%, ETN -2.59%, CEG -1.60%.
